paraphrase: Any app with financial features must file the Financial features declaration in Play Console and obey local financial law; binary options are banned; personal-loan apps must be in the Finance category, state repayment period, maximum APR and a representative total cost in the listing, never require full repayment within 60 days, never offer loans at 36% APR or more in the United States, and never access contacts or photos; earned-wage access, crypto and other products have their own conditions further down the page.
quote: Any app that contains any financial features must complete the Financial features declaration form within Play Console.
